// About SIERL

From Shore Base to Offshore Platform

SIERL is an integrated oil and gas services company supporting upstream and downstream operators across Nigeria and West Africa.

From exploration to production and infrastructure, we keep operations running — safely, reliably, and in full regulatory compliance.

// Our Services

Comprehensive Integrated Solutions

End-to-end support across the oil and gas value chain.
SVC—01

Oilfield Logistics & Procurement

Procurement and logistics for drilling, production, and maintenance.

  • Equipment & spare parts supply
  • Drilling consumables & chemicals
  • Warehousing & inventory management
  • Heavy equipment mobilization
  • 24/7 logistics coordination
SVC—02

Marine & Offshore Support

Marine logistics and vessel support for offshore operations.

  • Vessel chartering & OSV support
  • Crew boat services
  • Barge & cargo operations
  • Shore base operations
  • Personnel transportation
SVC—03

Technical & Infrastructure Support

Lifecycle support for oilfield equipment and infrastructure.

  • Pipeline maintenance & repairs
  • Storage & terminal operations
  • Mechanical & electrical maintenance
  • Fabrication & installation support
SVC—04

Project & Workforce Management

Project management and skilled manpower supply.

  • Project management support
  • Technical manpower supply
  • Non-technical workforce solutions
  • QA/QC inspection support
SVC—05

Petroleum Supply

Fuel supply and distribution for onshore and offshore operations.

  • Aviation fuel (Jet A-1) trading
  • Diesel & petroleum products
  • Fuel supply chain management
  • Quality assurance & testing
SVC—06

HSSE & Compliance

Zero-compromise health, safety, security, and environmental management.

  • HSE management systems
  • Risk assessment & mitigation
  • Environmental management
  • Regulatory compliance support

// Standards & Regulations

Compliance & Certifications

Full adherence to Nigerian and international frameworks.

Nigerian Content Compliance

Fully committed to the Nigerian Oil and Gas Industry Content Development (NOGICD) Act.

  • Registered with NCDMB
  • Nigerian Content Plans for all projects
  • 95%+ Nigerian workforce employment
  • Local procurement preference

Regulatory Compliance

Full compliance with Nigerian oil and gas regulators and legislation.

  • NUPRC regulated
  • Petroleum Industry Act (PIA) 2021
  • DPR standards adherence
  • NMDPRA compliance

HSE Standards & Certifications

Rigorous HSE management systems aligned with international best practices.
